sloka: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ ।हरीन् विशल्यान् सह लक्ष्मणेन चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे ।। ६.५९.१४६ ।।।।
transliteration: tasmin praviṣṭe rajanīcarendre mahābale dānavadevaśatrau ।harīn viśalyān saha lakṣmaṇena cakāra rāmaḥ paramāhavāgre ।। 6.59.146 ।।।।

translations.english: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.
